execution.invalid_detail: Both invalid returns were R on the within-cluster missing-odometry mask and used a mismatched opaque response ID. They were retained without rejudging.

primary_endpoint.cluster_resolution: Persistent discrepancy was a failure for both methods in both passes. Compensation was a failure for R in both passes and unresolved for P because the two passes disagreed.

failed_gates: recurring positive advantage in two mechanism families

diagnosis: P's deterministic renderer appended an unsupported certificate/declared-registry statement and omitted required measurements or limits on several guardrails. R added unsupported identifiers/source links and twice causally attributed response recovery to a Wait invocation. P therefore showed better causal restraint but worse material-error risk and useful coverage overall.
decision: Reject finite-checked-composition-deterministic-rendering-v1 for confirmation. Preserve all outputs and labels. Any successor must be a separately versioned development candidate, remove unsupported meta-claims, render every declared required unit, preserve conservative numeric bounds, and be tested on fresh configurations including positive geometry, visible-but-not-consumed evidence, and an out-of-model case before any confirmation freeze.
